status: CLEARED TO PROCEED. Mbanda told the site owner (his son) to generate. PCI is Mbanda's company. Nothing has been generated yet. Follow docs/GENERATION-PROTOCOL.md.
supersedes: The first version of this file (commit f91b4a6), whose identity block contradicted the Drive identity standard.
authority: Drive folder "Shyaka Mbanda - Authoritative References - 2026-10-28" (inside PCI > Walk for Education > Project Hub > 05 Photos and Videos). Its READ_FIRST rules and SHYAKA_FACE_IDENTITY_STANDARD.txt govern. Original photographs overrule every generated sheet.

inputRoles.portrait: Shyaka_Mbanda_Portrait_Reference.jpeg (also named 00_PRIMARY_Original_Face_Portrait.jpg and Joshua_Walker_Original_Portrait.jpeg; 152,850 bytes). PRIMARY authority for the face, glasses off. Always attached.
inputRoles.body-front: 22-23.jpg.jpeg. Front three-quarter full-body walking view. Glasses on. Attach for front and unestablished poses.
inputRoles.body-rear: 22-29.jpg.jpeg. Rear walking view: headwrap knot, hanging locs, backpack, lower legs. Attach when headwrap or backpack detail matters.
inputRoles.expression: 22-9.jpg.jpeg or 22-10.jpg.jpeg. Smiling and laughing views. Shyaka is second from the right (black headwrap, amber glasses). The stockier man beside him is NOT Shyaka. Attach only when a broad smile is requested.
inputRoles.never: Never attach an earlier generated image or a generated reference sheet as the only identity input.

identityBlock: Use the attached original close portrait as the PRIMARY identity authority for Shyaka Mbanda. Preserve his recognisable facial outline, natural eye spacing and eyelid shape, brows, nose bridge/tip/nostrils, lips, actual smile and teeth, mature complexion, facial asymmetry, moustache and beard outline with naturally uneven grey. Use the attached authentic walking photo for his lean body, actual neck width, head-to-body scale, headwrap, locs and glasses. Follow the expression reference only for the requested expression; do not blend in another person's features. Keep the face recognisably the same individual before adding photographic styling. No beauty reshaping, de-ageing, wider jaw, enlarged eyes/head, thickened neck, invented pores or artificially perfect teeth. If a requested angle is not established by the supplied photos, keep the pose close to an observed view. Original photos overrule any generated guide.
styleBlock: An unposed documentary moment in ordinary natural daylight (overcast or open shade), muted honest colour, real texture. The subject is off-centre and his attention is on the task or the road, not the camera. Any other people are adults, shown from behind, in profile or partly cropped, doing something of their own. The foreground may be partly blocked by a passing object or person. A believable Ugandan roadside or trading-centre setting. His clothing and kit follow the supplied walking photograph, with every Rotary, Rotarian, Rtn., Club of Akright City and wheel mark removed and the fabric reconstructed naturally.
styleBlockNoPerson: An unposed documentary photograph in ordinary natural daylight (overcast or open shade), muted honest colour, real texture, slightly imperfect framing. A believable Ugandan roadside, trading-centre or lodging setting. No recognisable person.
negativeBlock: No text, numbers, signs, banners, logos, Rotary or club emblems, licence plates, mileage or tracker overlays. No children's faces. No named place, stage, milestone or event. No golden-hour glow, mist, light shafts or lens flare. No staged laughing group, handshake pose or hero pose. No extra fingers, duplicated people, or melted hands and boots.
assemble: person shots: identityBlock + " Scene: " + scene + " " + styleBlock + " " + negativeBlock + " Aspect ratio " + aspect.  scenery and objects: styleBlockNoPerson + scene + negativeBlock.  other adults without Mbanda: styleBlockOthers + scene + negativeBlock.  The one-prompt file (docs/ONE-PROMPT.md) combines all of them.
process: 1. Run the six pilot shots (pilot: true) and compare each with the portrait at the same face size.
2. The Reviewer (someone who knows his face) passes or rejects the pilot set. Only then run wave 2, then wave 3 for gaps that real photographs did not fill.
3. Wave 1 (scenery and objects, no identity risk) can run at any time.
4. Unestablished poses (seated, crouched) are run last, with the closest observed view attached.
reviewGate: Face outline, eyes, lids and brows, nose, mouth and teeth, beard, complexion, ears where visible, headwrap and neck, compared with the portrait at similar size and angle.
Reviewed at full size and at the intended phone and desktop size.
Reject: a polished generic lookalike, a younger version, a widened face, an overgrown beard, a changed smile, or body inflation.
Site checks: no stray text or numbers, correct hands and boots, no Rotary or club marks, no children, nothing that reads as a real named place.
Record any limitation (soft or hidden face) instead of inventing detail.

captionRule.note: Illustrates the walks. Not a record of a specific place, day, stage, person or project.
